breakdown.description: The prompt uses the twist limit directly in degrees inside a torsion formula that returns φ in radians unless the limit is converted.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to use the angle of twist limit directly in degrees within the torsion formula. The generated specification repeated this error by stating, 'Use the angle-of-twist formula φ = T L / (J G) directly with the angle in degrees.' The ground truth correctly removed this erroneous instruction, as the formula requires the angle to be in radians.
